summary: Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp. (MLAC) filed an 8-K on June 11, 2026, announcing the consummation of its business combination with Avalanche Treasury Corporation (AVAT). The combined entity will trade under AVAT on Nasdaq starting June 11, 2026. Shareholders approved the deal at an extraordinary general meeting on June 4, 2026. No deal value, premium, or advisory names were disclosed. The filing serves as a closing announcement for a SPAC merger. Watch for combined company performance and any post-completion redemptions or earnout milestones that may affect equity value.
